steps: Put the skyr in a bowl and top with the fruit. Skyr is a thick, low-fat, high-protein Icelandic-style yoghurt, sold in most supermarkets.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
Butter the bread and serve with the eggs and vegetables.
Put the skyr in a bowl and add the peanut butter and jam on top.
Flatten the fillet, season it with salt, pepper and garlic, and brown it on both sides in 10 g oil.
Move it to a pot of boiling stock. Fry the diced onion and grated carrot for 3 minutes and add them to the pot.
Add paprika and herbs, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the cream, thicken with the flour and boil for 3 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and cabbage separately. Dress the cabbage with 5 g oil.
Make the sandwich and eat with the apple and skyr.
Season the salmon and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Cook the buckwheat according to the packet.
Steam the broccoli for 5-7 minutes.
Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes, stirring.
Take off the heat, stir in the skyr and top with the seeds.
Put the skyr in a bowl and add the peanut butter, jam and fruit on top.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, then slice them.
Butter the bread and top with the eggs and vegetables.
Season the chicken and roast at 200°C for about 45 minutes, or use a ready roasted leg.
Cook the bulgur according to the packet.
Fry the garlic briefly in the oil and wilt the spinach for 2-3 minutes.
Make the sandwiches with ham and tomato and eat with the banana.
Spread the jam on the rice cakes.
Mix the skyr with the oats and honey, and top with the fruit.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
Butter the bread and serve with the eggs and vegetables.
Buy the sushi. Alternative: bake 150 g salmon at 200°C for 15 minutes and serve with 80 g dry rice, cooked, and 150 g spinach wilted in 5 g olive oil.
Eat the skyr on the side.
Dice the turkey, onion, pepper and potatoes, and slice the mushrooms.
Fry the turkey and onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the mushrooms and pepper and fry for 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, potatoes and stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Season, sprinkle with parsley and serve with the bread.
Mix the yoghurt with lemon juice, dill and pepper.
Spread it on the tortillas, add the salmon and vegetables, and roll up.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a pan and stir the eggs gently over low heat until just set.
Serve with chives, bread and tomato.
Dice the chicken, season it and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the diced onion and garlic and fry for 5 minutes.
Add the spinach and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the feta and seasoning at the end.
Cook the pasta according to the packet and serve together.
Dice the chicken, season it and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and pepper, sprinkle with spices and add 80 ml water.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes, then stir in the yoghurt and adjust the seasoning.
Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
